Supreme Court Rules on Unrelied Documents in Trials

The Supreme Court has ruled that an accused person is entitled to seek the production of prosecution's unrelied documents at an appropriate stage during a trial. This decision settles a dispute regarding the use of such documents in legal proceedings.
